hero.label: Case Study: Delta Air Lines
hero.title: High-Fidelity Storytelling for an Iconic Brand
hero.subtitle: Leading the design team that unified Delta's digital newsroom, serving 90,000 employees and millions of passengers annually.

context.challenge: Elevating corporate communications to match the in-flight experience.
context.team: Multidisciplinary agency and Delta stakeholder teams
context.body: As UX Practice Leader for Sparks Grove, North Highland's innovation agency, I led the strategic consulting engagement for Delta News Hub. Delta's internal and external communications lived across fragmented legacy systems. The agency team unified corporate communications, media relations, and employee news in a cohesive platform designed to serve 90,000 employees and millions of customers.

sections.label: The Work
sections.title: Delta News Hub Leadership
sections.description: A multidisciplinary product and design team created a content-rich platform that balanced editorial storytelling with real-time operational priorities.

primaryCard.title: Editorial Architecture
primaryCard.description: A modular, category-driven framework gave the newsroom room to scale globally.

secondaryCards.title: Information Strategy
secondaryCards.description: The information architecture prioritized real-time audience needs without flattening the editorial hierarchy.

secondaryCards.title: Design Oversight
secondaryCards.description: A governed visual system preserved editorial quality across desktop and mobile touchpoints.

sections.label: Practice Leadership
sections.title: Transforming the agency.
sections.description: Delta was one expression of a broader practice transformation. As Practice Leader, I moved the agency from traditional waterfall delivery toward agile software development and lean product management, repositioning the practice around "Human Experience Design" (HxD). Over 2.5 years, that model helped win $2.7M in new business and supported product-methodology coaching for Fortune 500 executives, including leaders at The Home Depot. The transformation earned North Highland's National Impact Award in 2016.
